title: C2 native query plans over the retained Q4 volume workload
question: Do current generic and statistics queries expose the declared selective relationship indexes and the generated partial BM25 index on the retained run-scale data?
method: Restore Q4 in an owned database on 18/corpus; apply the explicitly recorded current projection/identity/payload/ingest adaptations; capture all twelve actual query implementations and inspect native EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS plans without planner forcing. Preserve failed attempts. This is access-path inspection, not semantic, throughput or full-run qualification.

agents.separation: isolated cq-serve worktree; production SQL and dedicated owned database; root owns integrated qualification

inputs.role: reproducible current-projection adaptation and plan inspection

outputs.role: full SQL/plans, failed attempts, environment, access-path summary and cleanup

conclusion: All twelve query implementations were inspected with zero final execution/EXPLAIN errors. Current BM25 ranking uses segment_bm25; selective transformations use claim_ref_target and claim_entity_ref_entity; profile joins use entity_identity_value. Forward edge hydration uses primary keys. Broad whole-run closure/identity scans are distinguished from selective access. The old Q4 BM25 predicate was inapplicable until replaced by the current generated overlay. No speed/capacity or semantic-answer claim follows. All owned databases were removed.
